how: Signals score each side from line moves at both books, the model projection, rest, home court, form and average margin.
A pick is made only when the game fits a rule that is on.
Rules were set from the 2023-24 to 2025-26 backtest and approved by Trina.
Picks grade Thin early in the season while ratings lean on last season.
notes: Nov 02: Starting settings from the 2023-24 to 2025-26 backtest: FAV_ML off (strict), DOG_ML on (strict), SPREAD_MOVE off (strict), UNDER_DROP on (lowered), OVER on (strict). Nov 02: MODEL_EDGE added and live: approved by Trina (backtest 1643-1452, +41.6u, 2 of 3 seasons). Nov 02: NEUTRAL_UNDER added and live: approved by Trina (backtest 515-403, +65.2u, 3 of 3 seasons). Nov 02: OVER (strict) confirmed live by Trina. Nov 03: EARLY_UNDER_OPEN added and live: backtest 219-158, +41.1u, 3 of 3 seasons. Nov 03: EARLY_OVER_OPEN added and live: backtest 233-173, +38.8u, 3 of 3 seasons. Nov 03: EFF_SPREAD added and live: backtest 1029-804, +131.5u, 3 of 3 seasons. Nov 03: EFF_OVER added and live: backtest 510-420, +43.6u, 3 of 3 seasons. Nov 03: All NCAAW rules frozen through Nov 8 (Trina): no automatic switches until after week 1. Records keep updating.. 24 games played this season through 2026-11-05. Nov 6: rules that failed the backtest now turn on automatically when green (Trina). Nov 6: graded Nov 5 card 4-3 (+0.49u). Re-check 31 games played. EFF_SPREAD (13-16, -4.18u) and MODEL_EDGE (13-14, -2.18u) are red past 20 picks and turn off Nov 9 unless green; SPREAD_MOVE (14-9, +3.73u) turns on Nov 9 if still green.

text: A rule is active only while its season to date and this month are both in the green (positive units).
Timing is unchanged: a rule can only switch off once it has 20+ season picks. The month counts once it has 5+ picks.
A rule turns off when its season units go negative, or this month goes negative on 5+ picks.
An inactive rule keeps being graded on every game it fits and turns back on when season and month are both green.

rules.back_on: Back on when season and month are both green (first possible switch Nov 9).
rules.desc: Favourite -200 to -100 with a signal lead of 2+ (3+ strict).
rules.label: Favourite moneyline
rules.note: Failed the backtest (needs positive units over three seasons and in 2 of 3). Trina, Nov 6 2026: turns on automatically when season and month are green (first possible switch Nov 9, after the freeze).

rules.desc: Underdog +100 to +200 with the signals on it.
rules.label: Underdog moneyline
rules.note: Passed the backtest: positive over three seasons and in 2 of 3.

rules.back_on: Green now: turns on Nov 9 when the freeze ends, if still green.
rules.desc: Spread on the side the line moved toward at both books with under 50% of tickets.
rules.label: Spread line move
rules.note: Failed the backtest (needs positive units over three seasons and in 2 of 3). Trina, Nov 6 2026: turns on automatically when season and month are green (first possible switch Nov 9, after the freeze).

rules.desc: Under when the total dropped at both books.
rules.label: Under on a dropping total
rules.note: Passed the backtest: positive over three seasons and in 3 of 3.

rules.desc: Over when the total rose at both books.
rules.label: Over on a rising total
rules.note: Passed the backtest: positive over three seasons and in 2 of 3. Thin: +1.3u on 371 picks, close to break-even. Kept live: approved by Trina Nov 2, 2026.

rules.desc: Side ATS when the projection beats the spread by 3+ points.
rules.label: Model edge 3+ vs spread
rules.note: Approved Nov 2, 2026. Side ATS when the projection beats the spread by 3+ points. Early season ratings lean on last season, so picks grade LOW.
rules.watch: Red at 27 picks (-2.18u): turns off Nov 9 when the freeze ends unless it gets back to green.

rules.label: Under at a neutral site
rules.note: Approved Nov 2, 2026. Under at neutral sites; strongest in March.

rules.desc: Nov and Dec only: under when the efficiency model total is 4+ below the opening total.
rules.label: Early season under vs the opener
rules.note: Live Nov 3, 2026 (same rule as the men). Nov and Dec only: under when the efficiency model total is 4+ below the opening total. Positive all three seasons.

rules.desc: Nov and Dec only: over when the efficiency model total is 4+ above the opening total.
rules.label: Early season over vs the opener
rules.note: Live Nov 3, 2026. Nov and Dec only: over when the efficiency model total is 4+ above the opening total. Positive all three seasons.

rules.desc: Side ATS when the efficiency model margin beats the spread by 3+.
rules.label: Efficiency model edge 3+ vs spread
rules.note: Live Nov 3, 2026. Side ATS when the efficiency model margin beats the spread by 3+. Positive all three seasons (2023-24 +97.4u, 2024-25 +11.1u, 2025-26 +23.0u).
rules.watch: Red at 29 picks (-4.18u): turns off Nov 9 when the freeze ends unless it gets back to green.

rules.desc: Over when the efficiency model total is 3+ above the posted total.
rules.label: Efficiency model total 3+ over
rules.note: Live Nov 3, 2026. Over when the efficiency model total is 3+ above the posted total. Positive all three seasons; most of the profit comes in Nov and Dec.
